svg.title: ech-codex-review: read-only cross-model review through Codex
svg.desc: The main session asks sol-reviewer, openai-gpt-diff-reviewer or openai-gpt-plan-reviewer for a review. Each forwards the diff or the plan to Codex and returns the findings verbatim, labelled ADVISORY. delegate-to-openai-astra forwards one task to GPT-6-Astra, only when the user names Astra. The codex-first-pr-review skill has Codex read the diff first through sol-reviewer, then a fresh reviewer checks only Codex's findings and the project invariants, and returns CLEAR or NOT CLEAR. Nothing in the plugin writes: no --write, no codex-rescue, no transfer.
svg.text: ech-codex-review · READ-ONLY: no --write, no codex-rescue, no transfer
Codex's findings verbatim, the changed files, the invariants

g.text: only when the user names Astra
a diff, after the normal review
the diff as a file, never a tree

svg.text: rectangle = agent or step · oval = model · green = request goes out · amber = findings come back · 🧠 = model: haiku
